title: Rancher usage event (flat event), contract 1.0.0
description: One flat event: the fixed keys event.name, time and schema_version, then one key per attribute. Consumers must accept keys they do not know.

time.description: The start of the UTC hour of the event, RFC 3339, as a whole hour.

schema_version.description: The contract version the event follows.

service.namespace.description: Groups every Rancher product's events under one namespace.
service.namespace.x-absent: The producer did not state a namespace; every producer of this contract is in io.rancher.

service.name.description: Names the producer; the producer is identified by this attribute alone.
service.name.x-absent: Never absent; the event is invalid without it.

service.version.description: Tells which release of the producer wrote the event. A customer-specific hotfix id is removed; a version that matches none of the forms this contract lists becomes _OTHER.
service.version.x-absent: Never absent; the event is invalid without it.

service.instance.id.description: A random id for one process, the same on every event that describes that process. It names no person and no machine.
service.instance.id.x-absent: Never absent; the event is invalid without it.

io.rancher.cli.config_directory.id.description: A random id per CLI config directory. It is not a user and not a machine: coding agents use several directories at once, and CI and test runs use new ones.
io.rancher.cli.config_directory.id.x-absent: The config directory id did not exist yet, or another process was creating it; treat the event as from an unknown config directory.

os.type.description: Tells which operating systems the producer runs on.
os.type.x-absent: The producer did not report an operating system.

host.arch.description: Tells which processor architectures the producer runs on.
host.arch.x-absent: The producer did not report an architecture.

io.rancher.client.type.description: A hint, never proof, of who ran the command: a coding agent, a person at a terminal, or automation (CI, scripts, kubectl calling the exec plugin, output piped to another program).
io.rancher.client.type.x-absent: The producer did not report who ran the command.

io.rancher.client.agent.description: Tells which coding-agent harness ran the command, from a fixed list; agent stands for a harness not on the list.

io.rancher.client.ci.description: True when an environment variable that a CI system sets was present; recorded beside the client type and never changes the client type.

io.rancher.cli.exec_plugin.description: True when kubectl ran the command as its exec plugin.

log.record.uid.description: A random id per event, never time-ordered; lets a consumer remove duplicates.
log.record.uid.x-absent: Never absent; the event is invalid without it.

io.rancher.cli.command.description: The command name (an alias is replaced by the name it stands for); never an argument value. Valid names are in the `rancher schema` manifest of the event's service.version.
io.rancher.cli.command.x-absent: The name did not follow the name rule and was left out.

io.rancher.cli.command.flags.description: The long names, without dashes and sorted, of the flags typed on the command line; never values and never flags set from the environment. At most 32 are kept (the first 32 sorted).
io.rancher.cli.command.flags.x-absent: Always written; an empty list means no flag was typed.

io.rancher.cli.command.outcome.description: Whether the command succeeded. An exit code that the command lists as success in the `rancher schema` manifest (`successExitCodes`) counts as ok.
io.rancher.cli.command.outcome.x-absent: The producer did not report an outcome.

error.type.description: The CLI error code of a failed command, or _OTHER when it has none.

process.exit.code.description: The exit code the process returns to its caller.
process.exit.code.x-absent: The producer did not report an exit code.

io.rancher.cli.command.duration.bucket.description: How long the command took, in three buckets; never an exact time.
io.rancher.cli.command.duration.bucket.x-absent: The producer did not report a duration.

io.rancher.manager.version.description: The version of the Rancher server the command targeted, by the same version rule.

io.rancher.manager.edition.description: The edition of the Rancher server the command targeted.

io.rancher.manager.install.id.description: The install id of the Rancher server the command targeted (its install-uuid setting), when the CLI could read it. It joins CLI use to a server installation.
io.rancher.manager.install.id.x-absent: The CLI did not have the id; io.rancher.cli.install_id.missing_reason says why.

io.rancher.cli.install_id.missing_reason.description: Why the install id is absent: no_server (the run had no server), not_permitted (the server's response was 403 or 404), not_fetched (no fresh response yet), invalid (the value was not a UUID). Present exactly when the install id is absent.

io.rancher.cli.events.dropped.description: One finished hour in which events were dropped: every slot (a numbered file) the producer tried was taken.

event.name.description: One finished hour in which events were dropped: every slot (a numbered file) the producer tried was taken.

time.description: The start of the UTC hour of the event, RFC 3339, as a whole hour.

schema_version.description: The contract version the event follows.

service.namespace.description: Groups every Rancher product's events under one namespace.
service.namespace.x-absent: The producer did not state a namespace; every producer of this contract is in io.rancher.

service.name.description: Names the producer; the producer is identified by this attribute alone.
service.name.x-absent: Never absent; the event is invalid without it.

service.version.description: Tells which release of the producer wrote the event. A customer-specific hotfix id is removed; a version that matches none of the forms this contract lists becomes _OTHER.
service.version.x-absent: Never absent; the event is invalid without it.

service.instance.id.description: A random id for one process, the same on every event that describes that process. It names no person and no machine.
service.instance.id.x-absent: Never absent; the event is invalid without it.

io.rancher.cli.config_directory.id.description: A random id per CLI config directory. It is not a user and not a machine: coding agents use several directories at once, and CI and test runs use new ones.
io.rancher.cli.config_directory.id.x-absent: The config directory id did not exist yet, or another process was creating it; treat the event as from an unknown config directory.

os.type.description: Tells which operating systems the producer runs on.
os.type.x-absent: The producer did not report an operating system.

host.arch.description: Tells which processor architectures the producer runs on.
host.arch.x-absent: The producer did not report an architecture.

log.record.uid.description: A random id per event, never time-ordered; lets a consumer remove duplicates.
log.record.uid.x-absent: Never absent; the event is invalid without it.

io.rancher.cli.events.dropped.count.description: How many events were dropped in one finished hour because every slot (a numbered file) the producer tried was taken. Consumers report usage as lower bounds when this event exists.
io.rancher.cli.events.dropped.count.x-absent: Never absent; the event is invalid without it.
